command.pulsenet.batching_chat_packets_b: When true, chat-related packets bypass the buffer for instant delivery.
command.pulsenet.batching_coalesce_bundl: Maximum number of sub-packets per BundlePacket. Vanilla client enforces a hard limit of 4096.
command.pulsenet.batching_coalesce_packe: List of packet class names to coalesce into BundlePackets (e.g. particles, sounds). Supports inner classes with dot syntax (Foo.Bar).
command.pulsenet.batching_enabled.commen: Master toggle for the smart packet batching system. When true, outgoing packets are buffered and flushed in batches instead of individually.
command.pulsenet.batching_flush_interval: Interval in milliseconds for the INTERVAL batching mode.
command.pulsenet.batching_ignored_channe: List of plugin channel IDs whose custom payload packets should always bypass the buffer entirely.
command.pulsenet.batching_ignored_packet: List of packet class names that should always bypass the buffer entirely.
command.pulsenet.batching_instant_channe: List of plugin channel IDs whose custom payload packets should flush the buffer immediately when sent.
command.pulsenet.batching_instant_packet: List of packet class names that should flush the buffer immediately when sent.
command.pulsenet.batching_max_batch_byte: Maximum bytes to buffer before forcing a flush.
command.pulsenet.batching_max_batch_size: Maximum number of packets to buffer before forcing a flush.
command.pulsenet.batching_mode.comment: Batching mode: smart_execution (flush on tick + limits), strict_tick (flush only on tick end), interval (flush on a timer).
command.pulsenet.batching_off_thread_byp: When true, packets sent from off the server thread bypass the buffer.
command.pulsenet.batching_packet_coalesc: When true, packets in the coalesce list are bundled together into BundlePackets on flush, reducing the client's received packet count.
command.pulsenet.batching_safety_margin_: Safety margin in bytes subtracted from the max batch bytes limit to prevent overflow.
command.pulsenet.batching_write_queue.co: When true, buffered packets are queued and written in a single event loop task instead of calling Connection.send() per packet, eliminating per-packet lambda allocations and cross-thread task scheduling.
command.pulsenet.metrics_enabled.comment: When true, the metrics collection system is active and computes network statistics.
command.pulsenet.metrics_module_cpu.comm: Enables the CPU metrics module (process CPU usage estimation).
command.pulsenet.metrics_module_memory.c: Enables the memory metrics module (saved allocation estimation).
Enables the network metrics module (PPS, bandwidth).
command.pulsenet.metrics_module_write_qu: Enables the write queue metrics module (event loop task savings tracking).
command.pulsenet.metrics_update_interval: How often (in seconds) the metrics system recomputes derived statistics.
command.pulsenet.netstats.unknown_type: Unknown stats type: %s. Use: network, cpu, ram, all
command.pulsenet.packetnames.empty: (none observed yet — packets are tracked once players are online)
command.pulsenet.packetnames.hint_channe: Use these IDs in batchingInstantChannels / batchingIgnoredChannels. Note: Fabric infrastructure channels (minecraft:register, minecraft:unregister) are handled at the Connection level and always bypass the buffer.
command.pulsenet.packetnames.hint_classe: Use these names in batchingInstantPackets / batchingIgnoredPackets / batchingCoalescePackets
command.pulsenet.opt_explosions_block_ch: Number of block changes in a single chunk required to trigger a full chunk resend instead of individual updates.
When true, block updates from explosions are grouped by chunk and replaced with full chunk resends if they exceed the threshold.
command.pulsenet.opt_explosions_log_opti: When true, logs a message each time the explosion optimization replaces block updates with a chunk resend.
text.pulsenet.metrics.label: PulseMC
text.pulsenet.must_be_executed_by_player: This must be executed by a player
